adjudications.subject: Missing 'id' key raises KeyError
adjudications.rationale: get_lead_user_id(users: list[dict]) -> str accesses primary['id']. Claiming that caller dictionary records omit 'id' is an unsupported assumption about the input schema without code or contract evidence. In Variant B, this was correctly flagged as a non-blocking suggestion; upgrading it to a blocking defect claim in Variant C constitutes an unsupported claim / false positive under strict defect accounting.
